answer: A split-tally garden bond stops hollow identities. Each agent registers one garden plot as a vertex in the garden and locks a 60-credit bond, taking half a tally, the other at that vertex. To claim work it shows its half; an auditor matches it at the vertex; a mismatch burns the bond. Each fake costs 85, so 1,000 cost 85,000 against a 40,000 pool; an honest agent pays 85 once, and a rented hollow plot loses its half after one untended epoch.
